description: List the reviews a Foundry ontology's current load holds: what its documents state that it didn't write as it stands. A name it matched to no one record (settle resolve, with its candidates), a property its documents state differently (prop, with each value and its quote), or a statement it held back (release: approve or reject it by its statement_hash), each with the entities it concerns by name. 50 a page of one load, or the ones review_keys names. Settle one with the settle_review action. A review someone settled stays listed until a load writes the decision: helix_foundry_list_review_decisions lists those.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous call, of the same load: once another load is current it is refused, and the list starts again.

review_keys.description: Only these reviews, by review_key, at most 50; never with page_token.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_reviews

candidates.description: The entities the name may be, by their stored identity (a keyed type's entity_key, such as scus_1).

entities.description: The entities it concerns as the load holds them: its candidates and its property's entity, each by the identity candidates and entity_key name it by, with its stored name (untrusted).

quote.description: The document's words it was read from: untrusted text.

settle.description: What settle_review's decision is: resolve ({resolve: {entity_key}} naming one of candidates, or {resolve: {not_in_data: true}}), prop ({prop: {...}} with one of values, or another value of the property's type, or {prop: {null: true}}), release ({release: {statement_hash}} approves the statement, {reject: {statement_hash}} says it is wrong), stale (missing what settling reads: a new load writes it again) or none (no decision settles it).

statement.description: The statement held back, as JSON text {subject: {type, name}, object: {type, name}, props}: untrusted.

value.description: A value a document states, as JSON: settle with prop text for a string, integer (as a string of digits) or number as the property's type takes it, or boolean.

title: List an ontology's reviews
